description.value: Welcome to Colonial Surfing Villa, a 150-year-old family heritage home thoughtfully adapted into a clean, safe, and budget-friendly guesthouse. Built by our ancestors and surrounded by a large tropical garden, the villa offers three comfortable rooms with private bathrooms and quality beds, as well as a shaded terrace where you can relax and listen to the ocean.

description_intro.value:
🇱🇰 Welcome to Colonial Surfing Villa, a family-run guesthouse offering comfort, privacy, and reliable service. 

Located just across the beach on Midigama’s main road, between Galle and Matara and close to Weligama and Mirissa, our villa provides clean rooms, respectful hospitality, and a peaceful base for surfing and exploring—while ensuring full guest independence. 

We remain available to assist with any services needed during your stay 🇱🇰
description_intro.author: owner (Airbnb listing summary; the same text without the flags opens listing 01)

description_area.value:
Our villa is ideally located in Midigama, just a short walk from some of the area’s best surf breaks: Lazy Left (200 m), Lazy Right (50 m), Ram’s (barrel spot), Whale Beach (50 m), Island, Coconut, and Plantation beaches. The area offers excellent snorkelling with turtles, fish, and cuttlefish, as well as whale- and dolphin-watching tours.

Nearby you’ll also find temples, markets, restaurants, supermarkets, a snake farm, turtle hatcheries, tea gardens, gem shops, and the local harbour—ensuring plenty to explore during your stay.
description_area.author: owner (Airbnb, "AREA & ACTIVITIES"; identical on listing 01)

description_stay.value:
Although my family and I live in the same historic house, your room is completely private and not shared with anyone. 

Each guest room has its own entrance from the common gate on the street, giving you full independence during your stay.

I enjoy helping guests feel at home and am always available if you need local tips or assistance, but I’m equally happy to remain discreet.

If you're looking for a genuine cultural experience, this is the place to stay!

quotes.text: We had a wonderful stay with Renuk and family. They were incredibly welcoming and made us feel at home from the moment we arrived. Thank you for hosting us so warmly, we would definitely love to visit again!
quotes.author: Rituraj

quotes.text:
After staying with Renuk's family for a week, we are super excited about the place and the people.
The family is energetic, friendly, extremely helpful and will welcome you with open arms. We felt very welcome, and everyone was always cheerful. 
The location of the house is nice, two good surf spots within walking distance and the other nice places (ahangama/weligama/coconut beach) are easy to reach by scooter.
The room looked very nice and well maintained on the inside. The piece of land could use some refurbishment here and there, but the space is great. The only thing that was a small minus point with our stay was the poorly functioning wifi.
Thanks :)

images_note: 137 distinct files kept from 182 gallery photos (Airbnb 02: 81, Airbnb 01: 38, Booking: 45 in the gallery + 18 more attached only to rooms); 45 exact re-uploads of the same photo across platforms were dropped (kept once, the larger copy; listed under also_on). Licence: 132 business-owned (host/property uploads), 5 unknown (img ids with flag possible_third_party: scenery or excursion shots whose authorship cannot be verified, and another business's surfboard rack). Usable as the business: 91 (rooms, bathrooms, details, food, the house, garden and veranda); 60 of them are ≥ 1920 px wide landscape (the CDNs serve at most 1920 px on the long side of these 4032–5712 px originals). Of those, the exterior/outdoor ones are img-029, img-030, img-052, img-073, img-075, img-137 (img-029 house corner with the roof sign, img-030 the house with a parked car and its hand-painted SURFING ROOMS sign, img-052 garden with the family tuk-tuk, img-073/img-075/img-137 the veranda); the other exteriors are 720–1600 px. 26 more are area-only (beach, reef, sunsets, railway — host uploads, never captioned as the villa). 15 show identifiable people (guests, the host family with children, strangers on a beach) and are not for the site without consent. Strongest: the Dec-2025 room set (timber ceilings, rattan pendants, red runners; e.g. img-001, img-053, img-070), the grey-stone bathrooms, the veranda hammock (img-075) and the house at dusk (img-002, colour-graded, 1440×1053). Weak: the exteriors are older phone shots in flat light; no photo of guests surfing from the house; no photo of the surfboards the owner says he rents.
videos_note: The business publishes no video: no website, no YouTube/Vimeo channel, no Instagram or Facebook found; the Airbnb and Booking galleries hold stills only. One YouTube hit for the name ("Surf & Chill at a Colonial Villa in Midigama, Sri Lanka", xYtg8r5WsYQ, Thepul Gajanayake, 2024-08-05) was fetched and its contact sheet looked at: a stock-footage montage (yoga, roller-skaters, models on generic beaches, "BRING YOUR CREW!", "COME TO Midigama Sri Lanka") with no frame of this house — a different villa or a promo; not recorded as this business's video and its files were deleted.
